search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and source extraction established the 2025 blade-manufacturing termination, but did not resolve the unspecified sole-status claim. Further evidence would need to define the relevant customer/partner scope and establish exclusivity.
The retrieved report is a reputable secondary account quoting Tien-Li's major announcement and Vestas; the underlying issuer filing was not independently retrieved.
The available revenue shares are consolidated-revenue percentages, not proof that Vestas was the sole customer or partner.
The scope of “sole” in the original wording is unspecified.
The cooperation termination is supported for blade manufacturing, not for all Vestas operations or relationships in Taiwan.
